NOT ROW-BOUND (criterion 3): the live /model at serving commit 89b3bc7586 renders exactly one tbody row, the USER (MODEL) aggregate (2 `<tr` tokens = 1 thead + 1 tbody). load_engine_truth() returns {}, load_raw_fills() returns 0 fills, wallet_gate is empty, so there is no non-user wallet row. TBL-13..TBL-24 therefore cannot quote a per-row value that would fail for a sibling row; the earlier 'one substring probe relabelled 13 times' defect is masked by an empty dataset, not cured.

SORT PERSISTENCE NOT PROVEN ON /model (criterion 4): every one of the 11 /sort/<col> endpoints returns 200 with that column active, and ui_state.json ranking does mutate (exit_count desc->asc on a second hit). But /model is served from a cached HTML snapshot and still showed WIN% active after /sort/pnl_per_hour and after /sort/exit_count. The named surface does not reflect the persisted ranking, so 'same column still sort-active after reload' is unverified there.
